d:
Inspector Patni catches Kutkutiya and his recovery goons red-handed when they threaten Tapu Sena in the society compound. He arrests them for extortion and threats, while society members agree to pay only the principal amount, refusing the fraudulent charges and high interest.
Step into Jethalal’s world with Gada Electronics! Manage the shop, tackle quirky customers, and experience nonstop TMKOC-style fun.
Are you ready for the challenge?
